learning_outcomes.text: Understand the composition, structure, and property connections in materials used in techniques and daily life.
Understand the opportunities to change and redirect material properties in a certain way.
Acquire useful knowledge and experience applicable in other subjects related to material processing or new product construction.

syllabus_topics: Main notions on the structure and properties of metal, dielectric and semiconductor crystal materials
Regularity of crystallization and transformations in hard condition – mechanisms and kinetics
Iron, steel and cast iron, copper, titanium, aluminum and their alloys
assessment_rules: Three tests are appointed during the semester. The test results are reflected in the exam's assessment.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
